No — I have no record of grepping _prof/src/pt_main.cpp for params.pad, params.seed or getenv this round, and I should not claim I did.

What I actually did with the profiling copy, from my own notes and the archive index for messages 30-58: I made a scratch copy in _prof/ whose params.pad field carries a PT_PROF bitmask (1 = skip shadow walk, 2 = skip mesh closest-hit, 4 = skip NEE, 8 = glass always-reflect), and the host-side edit for that went into _prof/src/pt_scene.cpp (that is the .cpp listed among the files I edited in that stretch — pt_main.cpp is not), with the shaders reading it in pt_trace.metal.

The one grep/compile finding I do remember about params.pad is #44: pt_intersect_scene has no local variable named `params`, so the shader had to read the flag as scene.params->pad — that came from a compile error in the profiling build, not from a grep of pt_main.cpp.

That scratch build produced the cost shares in #58 (512x512/64spp, gpu_ms_best): full 45.35, no shadow 44.05, no NEE 43.17, no mesh 4.77, i.e. the closest-hit BVH walk is ~89% of the frame. If you want the definitive answer about getenv/params.pad in _prof/src/pt_main.cpp, a single grep there would settle it; I have not run one.
